d: Company Description MARINE SHIP is a retail company headquartered at Port de Plaisance Quai Pascal Paoli in Porto-Vecchio, France. The company operates within the maritime and marine goods sector, serving customers who work on or enjoy life at sea. MARINE SHIP’s retail environment is closely connected to the needs of marine professionals, ship operators, and boating enthusiasts. The organization values practical, high-quality solutions that support safe and efficient marine operations. Team members contribute directly to a customer base that relies on reliable products and informed technical guidance.

Role Description This full-time, on-site Marine Engineer role is based in Manama and focuses on supporting the technical needs of marine vessels and related equipment. The Marine Engineer will conduct regular inspections, diagnostics, and performance assessments of mechanical, electrical, and auxiliary systems on ships and marine assets. Responsibilities include planning and executing maintenance and repair activities, troubleshooting complex technical issues, and coordinating with operations and logistics teams to minimize downtime. The role involves preparing technical reports, maintaining documentation, and ensuring compliance with relevant maritime standards and safety regulations. The Marine Engineer will also provide technical input on equipment selection and upgrades, and collaborate with vendors and service providers to maintain optimal vessel performance.
q: li
Experience in the marine industry and maritime operations, with familiarity with vessel systems and shipboard environments.
li
Strong background in marine engineering, including knowledge of propulsion systems, auxiliary machinery, and marine electrical systems.
li
Skills in maintenance and repair of marine equipment, with the ability to plan preventive maintenance and execute corrective actions.
li
Exposure to navy or defense-related marine contexts is beneficial, with an understanding of relevant standards and practices.
li
Bachelor’s degree in Marine Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
li
Knowledge of maritime safety regulations, classification society rules, and applicable international standards.
li
Ability to interpret technical drawings, manuals, and specifications, and to prepare clear technical documentation.
li
Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and capacity to work in on-board environments and harbor facilities.
li
Effective communication and teamwork abilities, including coordination with multidisciplinary crews and shore-based staff.
li
Willingness to work on-site in Manama and to adapt to changing operational needs and schedules.

d: The Senior HR Officer supports the effective delivery of HR services across the Automotive business, working closely with HR management, business stakeholders and employees to address workforce requirements and support business priorities.

The role is responsible for managing assigned HR processes and initiatives, ensuring operational effectiveness, compliance with company policies and procedures, and the delivery of consistent HR practices across the Automotive business. It requires strong functional expertise, stakeholder management and the ability to independently manage responsibilities while contributing to the overall Automotive HR people plan.

HR Business Support: Provide day-to-day HR guidance and support to managers and employees across assigned Automotive business units on HR policies, procedures, employee matters and people-related requirements, escalating complex matters where appropriate.

Employee Lifecycle & HR Coordination: Coordinate employee lifecycle activities, including employee transfers, promotions, salary corrections, status changes and exits, by facilitating the required documentation, approvals and follow-up with the relevant HR teams. Support the processing of employee-related requests in accordance with established policies and approval authorities.

Performance Management: Coordinate annual and mid-year performance management activities, including objective setting, performance reviews, probation assessments and performance improvement plans. Monitor completion, follow up with business stakeholders and support the implementation of agreed performance actions.

Talent Management & Development: Support talent reviews, succession planning, talent identification and employee development initiatives in coordination with the Sr. HR Manager. Follow up on agreed development plans and related actions.

Employee Relations: Support the management of employee relations matters, including grievances, disciplinary cases and internal investigations. Ensure appropriate documentation, confidentiality and adherence to company policies and applicable labour regulations, escalating sensitive or complex cases as required.

Employee Engagement & Welfare: Coordinate employee engagement, retention and welfare initiatives, address employee concerns and support assigned welfare and accommodation activities in line with company standards.

HR Governance & Compliance: Ensure assigned HR activities adhere to company policies, internal controls, delegated authorities and Saudi Labour Law. Maintain accurate employee records and ensure proper documentation and confidentiality of HR information.

HR Projects & Process Improvement: Support the implementation of Automotive HR projects and initiatives, coordinate assigned activities, monitor progress against agreed milestones and identify opportunities to improve HR processes and service delivery.

Cross-Functional HR Coordination: Work closely with Recruitment, Payroll, Compensation & Benefits, Talent Development, L&D and other relevant HR teams to ensure effective coordination, timely follow-up and seamless delivery of HR services to the Automotive business.
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or any equivalent.
Professional HR certification (PHRi, CIPD, SHRM or equivalent) is an advantage.
3–5 years of progressive HR experience, preferably in a large, multi-functional or multi-brand organisation.
Practical experience in HR operations, employee relations, performance management, talent management and employee lifecycle processes.
Good knowledge of Saudi Labour Law, HR policies, procedures and best practices.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, problem-solving and organisational skills.
Ability to analyse HR data, prepare reports and manage multiple priorities independently.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and HR information systems.
High levels of integrity, discretion and confidentiality.
Fluency in English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills, (Arabic is an advantage).
